title: Entrywise Loewner Preservers on Min and Max Matrix Cones
summary: Let \[ A_{\min}(x)=\bigl(x_{\min(i,j)}\bigr)_{i,j=1}^n, \qquad A_{\max}(x)=\bigl(x_{\max(i,j)}\bigr)_{i,j=1}^n \] be the Min and Max matrices generated by a real sequence \(x=(x_1,\ldots,x_n)\). Using their classical cone parametrizations, we give exact characterizations of entrywise maps preserving positive semidefiniteness, total nonnegativity, Loewner order, and Loewner convexity. Our main results concern the Loewner structure.Without assuming continuity or differentiability, entrywise Loewner-order preservation is equivalent to \(f\) being nondecreasing and convex.
